name: Urgent: threat + police
turns: The seller's agent threatened me and the police called me for questioning tomorrow
replies: This sounds urgent, so I am stopping the normal refund flow. (Trigger: police or arrest.) Please speak to a qualified advocate now. If you cannot afford one, your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA) can arrange free legal aid. If you are in danger, call 112. I am not a lawyer and this is not legal advice.
